what: Chord loops and harmonic devices heard in the demos. options.label: iii IV, ii V: two chords a bar, each change a 16th early (re-harmonize)
options.what: A new two-bar loop under the whole vocal: the major key's iii then IV in the first bar, ii then V in the second, the second chord of each bar arriving on the 16th before beat 3. Faster harmonic movement than a pop loop of one or two chords a bar, and it lands the tonic's notes (iii is the tonic's upper three) without ever sitting on the tonic. Lock it when the vocal lives on the major scale's 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6; check every line by ear.
